question.text: Interbank transactions in the Indian OTC forex market are settled through which entity?

explanation.text: The Logic: CCIL settles interbank OTC forex transactions in Cash, Tom, Spot and Forward USD-INR through multilateral netting, as described in the Currency Derivatives workbook. The Trap: The RBI is the regulator, not the settlement counterparty. The other distractors are clearing entities associated with exchange-traded segments and are not the interbank OTC forex settlement counterparty. Note: Source: NISM Series I (Currency Derivatives) workbook, p.21 — interbank OTC forex settlement through CCIL via multilateral netting.
